guide: Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: days before a client counts as lapsed, days without a touch, the passport validity you want after a trip, the days to flag a special date and the largest gift.
Check Advisors, Clients and Trips. They hold the people, clients and trips that every other sheet looks up. Each client has an advisor, a source and a loyalty tier.
Set Loyalty Tiers: the trips or the sales that earn each tier. The Clients sheet shows the earned tier and tells you when a client should move up.
Write each client profile on Client Profiles, each preference on Travel Preferences and each person who travels with them on Companions.
Record special dates on Special Dates and the offers you send on Birthday and Anniversary Offers. Anniversary Trips Due lists the next trips to suggest.
Log every contact on Touchpoints and every note on Client Notes with a follow-up date. Overdue follow-ups and clients without a touch are flagged for you.

Keep Passport and Visa Watch up to date for every traveller on a coming trip. The risk check compares the expiry with the trip end date and your validity setting. Always check the destination current rules.
Track Referrals, Reviews and Past Trip Ideas. Referrals show the sales and commission each referral brought, Reviews flags a low rating that needs a reply.
Work the Win-back List every month: the reason, the offer and the status of each client who has not travelled for a long time.
Use Client Segments, Newsletter List and Clients by Month to see which groups of clients are worth a campaign and how repeat business changes month by month.
Use the 14 calculators for lifetime value, repeat scores, next trip ideas, the contact plan, referrals, win-back offers, passports, concentration, segments, review timing, gifts and what-ifs.
Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details already written in.
Read the Client Dashboard and Charts every week: repeat share, reviews, referrals, contacts due, passports at risk and win-back status.

listing.title: Travel Agent Client Management Excel Template: Client Profiles, Repeat Clients, Loyalty Tiers, Referrals, Passport Watch, Win-back
listing.headline: Know every client and win their next trip
listing.description:
Run the client side of an independent travel agent or travel advisor business in one Excel workbook. Clients holds every client with their kind, interest, source, advisor and loyalty tier, and works out the trips, total sales, lifetime value (the commission and service fees a client has earned you), days since the last trip, days since the last touch and whether the client is a repeat client, lapsed or overdue for contact. Trips carries price per person, repeat bookings and the days between a client's trips. Client Profiles, Travel Preferences and Companions keep travel style, pace, budget level, dislikes, seat, room and meal preferences, and the passport expiry of everyone who travels with a client. Passport and Visa Watch compares every expiry with the trip end date and the validity you want, and flags a risk before the final payment (the balance due before travel). Check the destination current rules for every trip.

Special Dates, Birthday and Anniversary Offers and Anniversary Trips Due show who to contact and when. Touchpoints and Client Notes record every contact with a follow-up date. Referrals show the trips, sales and commission (the share of the price a supplier pays you after travel) each referral brought. Reviews, Past Trip Ideas, Win-back List, Client Segments, Newsletter List, Loyalty Tiers, Advisors and Clients by Month cover the rest of the client year.

14 calculators cover lifetime value, repeat-client score, next trip ideas, the contact plan, referral value, win-back offers, passport expiry, client concentration, segment size, review timing, gifts, anniversary trip pricing, the cost of winning against keeping a client and a repeat and referral what-if grid. Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and send 28 ready text messages that open with the details already written in.

This is part four of the Travel Agent suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data for a small advisor business to explore first. It helps you organise your client work and does not promise results.

messages.moment: Client: thank you for your review
messages.text: Hello {client}, thank you for your review of {destination}. It means a lot to the whole team.

messages.moment: Client: thank you for recommending us
messages.text: Hello {referrer}, thank you for recommending us to {referred}. We will take great care of them.

messages.moment: Client: your anniversary, a trip idea
messages.text: Hello {client}, on {anniversary_date} it is {years} years since {destination}. Our idea: {idea}. Shall we plan it?

messages.moment: Client: happy birthday from your advisor
messages.text: Hello {client}, warm wishes for {next_date} from your travel advisor. May the year bring good places to go.

messages.moment: Client: it has been a while, where next
messages.text: Hello {client}, it has been {months_since} months since your last trip. Where would you like to go next? {offer}.

messages.moment: Client: a new offer for your interest
messages.text: Hello {contact}, we found a new offer for {interest} trips. Would you like me to send you the details?

messages.moment: Client: school holidays, shall we plan
messages.text: Hello {client}, the school holidays start on {next_date}. Shall we plan a family trip while good rooms are still available?

messages.moment: Client: your loyalty tier is now
messages.text: Hello {contact}, your loyalty tier is now {earned_tier}. Thank you for travelling with us. Ask me about the benefits.

messages.moment: Client: a deal for your wish list
messages.text: Hello {client}, we found a deal that matches your wish: {wish}. Shall I send you the price?

messages.moment: Client: confirm your newsletter topics
messages.text: Hello {client}, please confirm the newsletter topics you want. We have {topics}. Reply with any change.

messages.moment: Client: your trip history is attached
messages.text: Hello {contact}, your trip history is attached: {trips} trips and a total of {sales}. Please tell us if anything is missing.

messages.moment: Client: check your companion passports
messages.text: Hello {client}, a gentle check on the passport of {name}: it expires on {passport_expiry}. Please confirm it is valid for your next trip.

messages.moment: Partner: thank you for sending a client
messages.text: Hello {referrer}, thank you for sending {referred} our way. We have booked {trips_brought} trips with them so far.

messages.moment: Owner: no trip for 12 months
messages.text: Hello, {client} has not travelled for {months_since} months. The last trip ended on {last_trip}. Past spend {past_spend}. Status: {status}.

messages.moment: Owner: a top client date is soon
messages.text: Hello, {client} ({tier}) has a special date on {next_date}, in {days_to} days: {note}. A personal call would be welcome.

messages.moment: Owner: this month contact list ready
messages.text: Hello, the contact list for {month} is ready. {new_clients} new clients, {bookings} bookings, {repeat_bookings} repeat bookings and {touches} touches so far.

messages.moment: Owner: a review of 3 stars needs a reply
messages.text: Hello, a review of {stars} stars from {client} about {destination} needs a reply. Comment: {comment}.

messages.moment: Advisor: clients to contact this week
messages.text: Hello {name}, you look after {clients} clients and {due_contacts} are overdue for contact. Please call the longest waiting ones this week.

messages.moment: Advisor: passport expires before trip
messages.text: Hello, the passport of {traveller} ({client}) expires on {expiry}. Check: {risk_flag}. Trip {trip_id} starts on {trip_start}. Please contact the client.

messages.moment: Advisor: a client reached a new tier
messages.text: Hello, {name} has reached a new tier: {earned_tier}. Please make a thank-you call and note it on the profile.

messages.moment: Freelance: send the review request batch
messages.text: Hello {name}, please send the review requests for the trips that ended in the last week. The list is on the Trips sheet.

messages.moment: Freelance: update the newsletter list
messages.text: Hello {name}, please update the newsletter list this week: new opt-ins, subscribers who stopped and changed topics.

documents.title: Client profile summary
paragraphs: Client profile summary of {set:company}, dated {today}. Client: {col:client_profiles.client}.
Travel style: {col:client_profiles.travel_style}. Pace: {col:client_profiles.pace}. Budget level: {col:client_profiles.budget_level}. Usual group size: {col:client_profiles.group_size}.
Please avoid: {col:client_profiles.dislikes}. Preferences held on file: {col:client_profiles.prefs}.

Trips taken with us: {col:client_profiles.trips_taken}, {col:client_profiles.nights_travelled} nights, about {col:client_profiles.spend_night} per night. The profile was last updated on {col:client_profiles.updated}.
Please read every line and tell us what to change. A correct profile saves time on every trip.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Trip history statement
paragraphs: Trip history statement of {set:company}, dated {today}. Client: {col:clients.name}, client since {col:clients.since}.
Trips booked with us: {col:clients.trips}. Total sales: {col:clients.sales}. Your last trip ended on {col:clients.last_trip}, which is {col:clients.days_since} days ago.
Your advisor is {col:clients.advisor}. Your loyalty tier is {col:clients.tier}.
The list of your trips with dates and prices is printed on the Client Profile Sheet. Please tell us if a trip is missing or wrong.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Preference sheet for suppliers
paragraphs: Preference sheet of {set:company} for a supplier, dated {today}. Client: {col:client_profiles.client}.
Travel style: {col:client_profiles.travel_style}. Pace: {col:client_profiles.pace}. Group size: {col:client_profiles.group_size}.
Please avoid: {col:client_profiles.dislikes}.
Share only what the supplier needs for this booking and only with the agreement of the client. Dietary, access and room needs are confirmed in writing before travel.
Please confirm that these notes are on the booking.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Thank-you letter after a trip
paragraphs: Thank-you letter of {set:company}, dated {today}.

Dear {col:trips.client}, welcome home. Thank you for travelling to {col:trips.destination} with us, {col:trips.nights} nights from {col:trips.start_date} to {col:trips.end_date} for {col:trips.travellers} travellers.
We hope the trip was everything you wanted. If anything fell short, please tell us so we can put it right and learn from it.
When you are ready to plan the next trip, we will be glad to help.
Your advisor is {col:trips.advisor}.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Referral thank-you note
paragraphs: Thank-you note of {set:company}, dated {today}.
Dear {col:referrals.referrer}, thank you for recommending us to {col:referrals.referred} on {col:referrals.date}.
So far they have booked {col:referrals.trips_brought} trips with us. Your recommendation matters more than any advertising we could buy.
We will take good care of them, and we would be glad to help anyone else you know who is planning a trip.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Review request letter
paragraphs: Review request of {set:company}, dated {today}.
Dear {col:trips.client}, we hope you enjoyed {col:trips.destination}, which ended on {col:trips.end_date}.
Could you take two minutes to tell others about your trip? A few honest lines about what you enjoyed and what we could do better are enough.
Thank you for your time. Your advisor, {col:trips.advisor}, reads every review.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Anniversary trip offer
paragraphs: Anniversary trip offer of {set:company}, dated {today}. Client: {col:anniversary_trips.client}.
On {col:anniversary_trips.anniversary_date} it will be {col:anniversary_trips.years} years since your trip to {col:anniversary_trips.destination}, trip {col:anniversary_trips.original_trip}.
Our idea: {col:anniversary_trips.idea}. That trip cost {col:anniversary_trips.original_price}. We will price a first quote for a similar budget with no obligation.
Tell us if you would like to hear more.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Win-back letter
paragraphs: Letter of {set:company}, dated {today}.
Dear {col:winback.client}, it has been {col:winback.months_since} months since your last trip, which ended on {col:winback.last_trip}. We have missed planning with you.
As a client at the {col:winback.tier} tier, we would like to offer you this: {col:winback.offer}.
If your plans or your budget have changed, tell us. We are happy to start with a short call and no commitment.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Client loyalty statement
paragraphs: Loyalty statement of {set:company}, dated {today}. Client: {col:clients.name}.
You have travelled with us {col:clients.trips} times since {col:clients.since}, with total sales of {col:clients.sales}.
Your loyalty tier is {col:clients.tier}. Based on your trips and sales, the earned tier is {col:clients.earned_tier}.
Tier benefits are agreed with your advisor, {col:clients.advisor}. Thank you for your trust.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Top clients and segments report
paragraphs: Segment report of {set:company}, dated {today}. Segment: {col:segments.segment}.
Rule: {col:segments.rule}. Clients in the segment: {col:segments.clients}.
Sales of the segment: {col:segments.sales}. Average value per client: {col:segments.avg_value}. Share of all sales: {col:segments.share}.
Size check: {col:segments.size_flag}. The actions for this segment and the person who owns each one are written below.

steps.label: Collect companion names and passport expiry
Add the client to the newsletter with their consent
Check budget level and group size
Update dislikes after the last trip
Send the profile to the client to check
Record the date of the check
List expiry dates in the next 12 months
Ask the client to check each passport
Check the destination current rules for each trip
Ask for a renewal if the validity is short
Note the check on the trip file
Call the client within three days
Ask what worked and what did not
Share the praise with the supplier
Note a referral if one was given
Ask for a referral if the rating is five stars
Add the comment to the profile
Send the thank-you note to the referrer
Report back when the first trip is booked
Hold the dates with the supplier
Read the last trip and the notes
Move to the newsletter only if the client has no interest
List the top 20 clients by sales
Check each has a call planned
Review the clients overdue for contact
Set the actions for the next quarter
Archive clients with no trip and no contact for three years
Merge notes of one client under one profile
Export the client list as a backup

Der Risikocheck vergleicht den Ablauf mit dem Reiseendedatum und Ihrer Gültigkeitseinstellung. Überprüfen Sie immer die aktuellen Regeln des Zielorts.

it.Dear {col:referrals.referrer}, thank you: Caro {col:referrals.referrer}, grazie per averci consigliato a {col:referrals.referred} su {col:referrals.date}.
it.So far they have booked {col:referrals.t: Finora hanno prenotato {col:referrals.trips_brought} viaggi con noi. La tua raccomandazione conta più di qualsiasi pubblicità che potremmo acquistare.

it.Could you take two minutes to tell other: Potresti dedicare due minuti a raccontare agli altri il tuo viaggio? Sono sufficienti poche righe oneste su ciò che ti è piaciuto e su cosa potremmo fare meglio.

it.If your plans or your budget have change: Se i tuoi piani o il tuo budget sono cambiati, comunicacelo. Siamo felici di iniziare con una breve chiamata e senza impegno.

it.Open Start and type your company name an: Apri Start e digita il nome della tua azienda e i tuoi limiti nelle celle gialle: i giorni prima che un cliente venga considerato decaduto, i giorni senza un tocco, la validità del passaporto che desideri dopo un viaggio, i giorni per contrassegnare una data speciale e il regalo più grande.
it.Check Advisors, Clients and Trips. They: Controlla consulenti, clienti e viaggi. Contengono le persone, i clienti e i viaggi che ogni altro foglio cerca. Ogni cliente ha un consulente, una fonte e un livello di fidelizzazione.
it.Set Loyalty Tiers: the trips or the sale: Imposta Livelli di fedeltà: i viaggi o le vendite che guadagnano ogni livello. Il foglio Clienti mostra il livello guadagnato e ti dice quando un cliente dovrebbe salire.
it.Write each client profile on Client Prof: Scrivi ogni profilo cliente su Profili dei clienti, ogni preferenza su Preferenze di viaggio e ogni persona che viaggia con loro su Companion.
it.Record special dates on Special Dates an: Registra le date speciali su Date speciali e le offerte che invii su Offerte per compleanni e anniversari. Viaggi per l'anniversario in scadenza elenca i prossimi viaggi da suggerire.
it.Log every contact on Touchpoints and eve: Registra ogni contatto su Touchpoint e ogni nota su Note del cliente con una data di follow-up. I follow-up scaduti e i clienti senza tocco vengono contrassegnati per te.
it.Keep Passport and Visa Watch up to date: Tieni aggiornato Orologio con passaporto e visto per ogni viaggiatore in arrivo. Il controllo del rischio confronta la scadenza con la data di fine del viaggio e l'impostazione di validità. Controlla sempre le regole attuali della destinazione.
it.Track Referrals, Reviews and Past Trip I: Tieni traccia di referral, recensioni e Idee per viaggi passati. I referral mostrano le vendite e le commissioni apportate da ciascun referral, le recensioni contrassegnano una valutazione bassa che necessita di una risposta.
it.Work the Win-back List every month: the: Lavora il Elenco di riconquista ogni mese: il motivo, l'offerta e lo status di ogni cliente che non viaggia da molto tempo.
it.Use Client Segments, Newsletter List and: Utilizza Segmenti di clientela, Elenco newsletter e Clienti per mese per vedere quali gruppi di clienti valgono una campagna e come cambia il business ripetuto mese dopo mese.
it.Use the 14 calculators for lifetime valu: Utilizza i 14 calcolatori per il valore della vita, i punteggi ripetuti, le idee per il prossimo viaggio, il piano di contatto, i referral, le offerte di riconquista, i passaporti, la concentrazione, i segmenti, i tempi di revisione, i regali e le ipotesi.
it.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Stampa 10 fogli e 10 documenti, segui 10 liste di controllo e tocca il collegamento di un messaggio per inviare un messaggio con i dettagli già scritti.
it.Read the Client Dashboard and Charts eve: Leggi il Cruscotto cliente e le classifiche ogni settimana: condivisione ripetuta, recensioni, segnalazioni, contatti scaduti, passaporti a rischio e stato di recupero.
it.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Tutti gli elenchi a discesa del file. Modifica qui una voce e si aggiornerà in tutti i fogli.
it.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Si aggiorna dai tuoi fogli. Cambia l’anno per consultare i dati passati.
it.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Scegli nella cella gialla; il resto si compila da sé. Il modulo è pronto da stampare.
it.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Modifica qui il testo; le parole tra {braces} vengono compilate usando i dati di ogni riga. I collegamenti si trovano nelle tabelle.
it.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Scegli una voce: ogni passaggio avrà la propria data di scadenza. Crea una copia di questo foglio per ogni voce.
it.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Grafici aggiornati dai tuoi fogli. Scegli nelle celle gialle e tutti i grafici e gli indicatori si aggiorneranno.
